{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Ithorian-NEGAS.png|thumb|right|200px|Ithorians were strict vegetarians.]]
{{Quote|He mixed a promising herb into a kettle of meat soup. Zorneth – a strict vegetarian, like all Ithorians – politely declined a taste. Vilia apologized for offering meat to an Ithorian.|PDA6|<ref name="Droids8">[[Droids (1995) 8|''Droids'' (1995) 8]]</ref>}}
The term '''vegetarian''' referred to a person or creature who followed a [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-based diet and did not eat meat. [[Tarasin]]s were normally vegetarians, and [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] were strictly vegetarian, as were [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] virgins. [[Bilar]]s were another vegetarian [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>
